key_impacts: Flooding exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide in New York City.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway refineries were shut down, removing 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD capacity.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outages.
Metropolitan Transportation Authority river crossings were damaged.
evidence_snippets: Arrival on the evening of October 29 generated a massive surge; flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain by 53% citywide in New York City.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
As of November 6, 2012, Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway refineries were shut down in New Jersey.
missing_information: Event duration beyond the 2012-10-29 arrival not fully specified
